prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a magazine beauty cover portrait of a generic adult woman. Front-facing, chin slightly lowered, eyes locked directly into camera with quiet confidence. One hand is raised elegantly, fingers sculpted and spaced, partially framing one eye without covering the face. Keep the pose minimal, powerful and editorial. She wears sheer black mesh gloves on both hands, multiple stacked diamond rings including a large solitaire, diamond eternity bands, layered slim diamond bangles and one thicker bracelet, a diamond tennis choker fitted closely to the neck and matching diamond stud earrings. Outfit is a deep black halter-neck couture gown with a clean neckline and luxury fabric. Hair is softly voluminous with natural movement. Makeup uses realistic skin texture, softly sculpted cheekbones, warm nude lips, refined lashes and subtle smoky eyes. Use soft directional studio lighting, gentle shadow sculpting, a medium-format editorial lens and neutral gray background. Render 8K photorealistic high-fashion editorial realism in a 9:16 frame without reproducing any public-figure likeness.
